our_interpretation: Half refers to five of the ten announced mathematical results.
The scare quotes allow different proofs and experimental procedures; they do not require reproducing OpenAI's exact reasoning.
The asserted event is obtaining the mathematical results, not merely announcing that they were obtained.
The target period covers the announcement and reported replication on August 1–2. Earlier model availability is supporting context.
The methodological caveats are qualifications of an observation, not antecedents of a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Dated evidence establishes that Alpöge obtained valid solutions corresponding to five announced results using the publicly released Fable within approximately 24 hours.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish fewer than five corresponding solutions, a materially longer elapsed time, or use of a different or unreleased model.
